summary: Based on OpenRouter API, there are 8 free Nemotron models available from NVIDIA: (1) Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free) - 3B active parameters, 1M context window; (2) Nemotron 3 Embed 1B (nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b:free) - text embedding model; (3) Llama Nemotron Rerank VL 1B V2 (nvidia/llama-nemotron-rerank-vl-1b-v2:free) - 1.7B multimodal reranking model; (4) Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-content-safety:free) - 4B parameter guardrail model, 128K context; (5) Nemotron 3 Ultra (nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free) - 55B active parameters, 1M context; (6) Nemotron 3 Nano Omni (nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning:free) - 30B multimodal, 256K context; (7) Nemotron 3 Super (nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free) - 120B hybrid MoE, 1M context; (8) Llama Nemotron Embed VL 1B V2 (nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2:free) - multimodal embedding model. All are priced at $0/M input tokens and $0/M output tokens.
